constructor.details: Reverts if `gamingToken_` is the zero address.Reverts if `lockingPeriod` is zero.Reverts if `tierIds` and `amounts` have different lengths.Reverts if any element of `amounts` is zero.

params.amounts: The amounts of gaming token to escrow for participation, for each one of the `tierIds`.
params.lockingPeriod_: The period that a participant needs to wait for leaving a tier after entering it.
params.tierIds: The identifiers of each supported tier.

enterTier(bytes32,uint256).details: Reverts if `tierId` does not exist.Reverts if 'deposit' is less than minimumAmountToEscrowReverts if the sender is already participant in the tier.Emits a ParticipationUpdated event.An amount of ERC20 `gamingToken` is transferred from the sender to this contract.

params.tierId: The identifier of the tier to enter.

exitTier(bytes32).details: Reverts if the sender is not a participant in the tier.Reverts if the tier participation of the sender is still time-locked.Emits a ParticipationUpdated event.An amount of ERC20 `gamingToken` is transferred from this contract to the sender.

params.tierId: The identifier of the tier to exit.

increaseDeposit(bytes32,uint256).details: Reverts if `tierId` does not exist.  Reverts if user is not in tier.     Emits a ParticipationUpdated event.An amount of ERC20 `gamingToken` is transferred from the sender to this contract.

params.tierId: The identifier of the tier to increase the deposit for.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.participant: The participant to check the status of.

returns.timestamps: The enter timestamp for each of the the `tierIds`. Zero values mean non-participant.

pause().details: Reverts if the sender is not the contract owner.Reverts if the contract is paused already.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner.      * NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Reverts if the sender is not the contract owner.Reverts if the contract is not paused.

devdoc.title: TimeTrialEliteLeague. Contract which manages the participation status of players to the elite tiers. Entering a tier requires the participant to escrow some ERC20 gaming token, which is given back to the participant when they leave the tier.

enterTier(bytes32,uint256).notice: Enables the participation of a player in a tier. Requires the escrowing of an amount of gaming token.

exitTier(bytes32).notice: Disables the participation of a player in a tier. Releases the amount of gaming token escrowed for this tier.

increaseDeposit(bytes32,uint256).notice: Updates amount staked for participant in tier

participantStatus(address,bytes32[]).notice: Gets the partricipation status of several tiers for a participant.
